sv.title: Bekräftar: MFF pausar samarbetet med Olympic
sv.summary: Malmö FF sätter samarbetet med BK Olympic på paus. – Det kommande året kör vi själva och så ser vi vad vi vill sen, säger Ahmed Chahrour, sportchef i BK Olympic.

en.title: Confirmed: MFF pauses cooperation with Olympic
en.summary: Malmö FF is putting its cooperation with BK Olympic on hold. "For the coming year we will go it alone, and then we'll see what we want after that," says Ahmed Chahrour, sporting director at BK Olympic.
